name: lulu
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one standalone Kalistar illustration, never a card or contact sheet. Deliver a true 4:5 portrait, ideally 1024 x 1280, edge-to-edge painting. Image 1 Momo is the primary STYLE reference: visible rich brushwork, large painted color planes, narrative emotion, worn material, controlled edges. Image 2 Valazar is secondary STYLE reference for volumes and textured materials, NOT an instruction to make every scene gloomy. Image 3 is IDENTITY reference only: preserve recognizable FF10 face/hair/costume cues but DO NOT copy its portrait pose, smooth rendering, white background or anime stylization. Render the face with the SAME textured, mature painterly treatment as the Kalistar references, natural eye scale, no anime or photographic skin.
Composition: a 737 x 921 card-art window will contain this image. Keep face and main hands within central x20-78%; all essential equipment within x18-80%. Show full body or generous three-quarter figure with margin above head, enough breathing room below action and lateral margins. Character is large and legible, not tiny. Main contrast on face and story gesture. Restrained evocative background with broad values, no dense crowd. Coherent anatomy: one head, exactly two arms and two legs; coherent hands, contacts and continuous equipment.
No text, numbers, lettering, logos, watermark, card frame, barcode, interface, photo, polished 3D, manga, artificial glamor pose, extra limbs, uniform digital noise. This is an original scene interpretation, not a copied game screenshot.
Subject and scene: Lulu, adult black mage from the ORIGINAL FINAL FANTASY X, at the threshold of the Farplane near Guadosalam. Long black braids with her signature braided updo, several ornate colored hairpins, loose dark bang over one side, warm reddish-brown eyes, small beauty mark near lips and muted purple lipstick, recognizable from reference. Her dark floor-length belted dress has a soft brown-fur collar and many broad leather belts forming the long skirt; authentic tasteful silhouette, fully clothed and no cleavage emphasis. She sits or stands in a quiet three-quarter pose beside an old mossy stone rail, figure shown from head through long skirt, centered and large. She gently cradles her WHITE MOOGLE PLUSH weapon at waist/chest height with TWO anatomically coherent hands visibly supporting its soft body. Moogle recognizable: rounded white cloth body, little ears, red ball pompom on a short stalk, tiny purple bat wings, closed simple eyes and stitched details. The plush is a TOY with sewn texture, not a live creature. The game weapon is Grimoire but DO NOT draw a book; the plush is the only held prop. Her gaze is lowered toward a distant glowing memory in the mist, stoic face with restrained protective tenderness and a trace of grief, not blank and not smiling like a model. Restrained otherworldly Guadosalam setting: a softly luminous misty water basin, pale rootlike shapes/organic columns, a little dim pink-violet vegetation, no detailed faces or ghost crowd in background. Natural cool reflected mist light and a quiet warm highlight on face and plush. Match the worn velvet, leather, fur and painterly facial volumes of Momo/Valazar, no smooth anime portrait.
